These intermediates ultimately target the Photosynthetic reaction center cytochrome c subunit, indicating a possible pathway through which the compound may exert its effects. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, but the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain, as the strength of the evidence is moderate, and the pathways are not fully characterized. The integration of these findings suggests a possible role in the photosynthetic process, though further experimental validation is required to confirm the direct involvement of the compound in this pathway.
